Title: Espresso Vivace
Note: Cap on the sidewalk. The rosetta on top is the whole point.

Title: Victrola Coffee Roasters
Note: Capitol Hill's long table. Good for two hours of not moving.

Title: Milstead & Co.
Note: Fremont. They rotate roasters, so ask what is on today.

Title: Analog Coffee
Note: Small, loud, excellent. Corner windows on a grey day.

Title: Cafe Allegro
Note: Down an alley by the U District. Oldest espresso bar in the city.

Title: Elm Coffee Roasters
Note: Pioneer Square. Quiet, bright, and the pastry case is real.
